```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggplot2)
library(multcomp)
#install.packages("writexl")
library (writexl)
```


```{r}
# 1) Load + standardize column names
df_raw <- read_excel("~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Raw_data/Consortia/BDS sleceted bacteria_consortia_LB 2026.xlsx") %>%
  rename(
    Rep = Replicate,
    severity_leaf = Diseased_leaf_area
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment),
    Rep       = factor(Rep),
    Plant     = factor(Plant),
    Leaf      = factor(Leaf),
    severity_leaf = as.numeric(severity_leaf)
  )

View(df_raw)

```


```{r}

# 2) Plant is the experimental unit: average leaves within plant
df_plant <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(Rep, Treatment, Plant) %>%
  summarise(severity = mean(severity_leaf, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = relevel(Treatment, ref = "Diseased control"),
    severity_pos = severity + 0.5
  )

# sanity check
df_plant %>% count(Rep, Treatment)

# 3) Fit model (run-to-run variability)
m1 <- glmmTMB(
  severity_pos ~ Treatment + (1 | Rep),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = df_plant
)
summary(m1)

# Diagnostics (optional, but good to keep)
res <- simulateResiduals(m1, n = 1000)
plot(res)

# 7) Estimated marginal means
emm <- emmeans(m1, ~ Treatment)


# 1) EMMs on the response scale (back-transformed)
emm_resp <- emmeans(m1, ~ Treatment, type = "response")
emm_df   <- as.data.frame(emm_resp)
emm_df
```

```{r}
# 0) Canonical clean function
clean_trt <- function(x) str_squish(as.character(x))

# 1) EMMs on response scale
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(m1, ~ Treatment, type="response")) %>%
  mutate(Treatment = clean_trt(Treatment))

mu0 <- emm_df$response[emm_df$Treatment == "Diseased control"]

plot_df <- emm_df %>%
  filter(!Treatment %in% c("Diseased control", "Non-treated control")) %>%
  mutate(
    perc_reduction = (1 - response/mu0) * 100,
    perc_low  = (1 - asymp.UCL/mu0) * 100,
    perc_high = (1 - asymp.LCL/mu0) * 100,
    ymin1 = perc_reduction,
    ymax1 = perc_high
  )

# 2) Your desired order (MUST match cleaned labels)
treat_order <- clean_trt(c(
  "Copper standard",
  "Cons 5 (Pb39+ Pb177+ Pb460)",
  "Cons 1 (Pb39+ Pb177)",
  "Cons 3 (Pb177+ Pb460)",
  "Cons 6 (Pb39+ Pb460)",
  "Pseudarthrobacter sp. Pb177",
  "Pseudomonas sp. Pb460",
  "Streptomyces sp. Pb39"
))

# 3) CLD on the same set, same cleaning
emm_for_cld <- emmeans(m1, ~ Treatment) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Treatment = clean_trt(Treatment)) %>%
  filter(Treatment %in% treat_order)

# safest: rebuild an emmGrid with only treatments we plot
emm_for_cld_grid <- emmeans(m1, ~ Treatment) %>%
  subset(Treatment %in% treat_order)

cld_tbl <- multcomp::cld(emm_for_cld_grid, Letters=letters, adjust="tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    Treatment = clean_trt(Treatment),
    cld = str_replace_all(.group, "\\s+", "")
  )

# 4) Join + force factor levels AFTER join
plot_df2 <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Treatment = clean_trt(Treatment)) %>%
  left_join(cld_tbl, by="Treatment") %>%
  filter(Treatment %in% treat_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treat_order),
    cld = ifelse(is.na(cld), "", cld)
  )

# sanity check (do this once)
print(levels(plot_df2$Treatment))
print(unique(as.character(plot_df2$Treatment)))

# 5) Plot (order guaranteed)
p <- ggplot(plot_df2, aes(x=Treatment, y=perc_reduction)) +
  geom_col(width=0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = perc_reduction, ymax = perc_high), width=0, linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(y=ymax1 + 4, label=cld), size=5, vjust=0) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +   # <- critical
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,115), breaks=seq(0,100,20), expand=c(0,0)) +
  labs(x="Treatment", y="Disease reduction vs diseased control (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=13, angle=60, vjust=1, hjust=1, face="italic"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
    axis.title  = element_text(size=14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "BDSf_consortia_LB.tiff",
  plot = p,
  path = "~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Outputfiles/Plots",
  width = 7.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, units = "in",
  device = "tiff", compression = "lzw"
)

```
